watches.name: Rolex
watches.shortDescription: An iconic dive watch with a black dial and unidirectional bezel.
watches.fullDescription: Designed for underwater exploration, the Submariner Date pairs a highly legible display with a robust Oystersteel case, a date window, and a precise automatic movement.

watches.name: Omega
watches.shortDescription: A hand-wound chronograph inspired by the watch worn on the moon.
watches.fullDescription: The Speedmaster Moonwatch is a celebrated chronograph with a black stepped dial, tachymeter bezel, and a hand-wound movement developed for precise elapsed-time measurement.

watches.name: Seiko
watches.shortDescription: A refined automatic dress watch with a textured dial.
watches.fullDescription: Inspired by classic cocktail culture, this Presage features a richly patterned dial, polished hands, a mechanical automatic movement, and a versatile stainless-steel case.

watches.name: TAG Heuer
watches.shortDescription: A sporty racing chronograph with a clean, legible dial.
watches.fullDescription: Built around the spirit of motorsport, the Carrera Chronograph combines clear timing counters, a precise automatic chronograph movement, and a refined stainless-steel case.

watches.name: Casio
watches.shortDescription: A slim, shock-resistant watch with an analog-digital display.
watches.fullDescription: The octagonal GA-2100 is built for everyday toughness with a shock-resistant structure, practical analog-digital timekeeping, and a lightweight carbon-reinforced resin case.

watches.name: Tissot
watches.shortDescription: A modern automatic watch with an integrated steel bracelet.
watches.fullDescription: Inspired by a 1970s design, the PRX Powermatic 80 pairs a slim tonneau-shaped case with an integrated bracelet, a textured dial, and an automatic movement with an extended power reserve.

watches.name: Citizen
watches.shortDescription: A capable solar-powered dive watch with high-visibility markers.
watches.fullDescription: Made for underwater use, the Promaster Diver combines bold luminous markers, a rotating bezel, a screw-down crown, and Citizen Eco-Drive technology that charges in light.

watches.name: Longines
watches.shortDescription: A versatile sports watch with a ceramic dive bezel.
watches.fullDescription: The HydroConquest combines a polished ceramic bezel, clear luminous markers, and a self-winding mechanical movement in a balanced stainless-steel case made for active use.

watches.name: Apple
watches.shortDescription: A connected smartwatch with activity and health features.
watches.fullDescription: Apple Watch Series 10 provides connected notifications, activity tracking, and health features in a lightweight case with a bright always-on display and digital timekeeping.

watches.name: Orient
watches.shortDescription: A timeless automatic dress watch with a domed crystal.
watches.fullDescription: The Bambino Version 8 features a clean dial, domed crystal, slim hands, and a dependable automatic movement, styled for formal occasions and everyday wear.
watches.caliberAndMovement: Calibre F6724, automatic with manual winding
